label: What a virtual office costs

meta.title: Virtual Office Software Cost in 2026: What a Team of 5, 10 or 15 Pays
meta.description: What ten virtual offices cost a remote team of 5, 10 and 15 people a month, from each pricing page on 3 November 2026, and what else changes the bill.

coverAlt: A stack of yellow coins beside a small desk with a laptop, a plant and a yellow chair, on a sky-blue background.
title: What does a virtual office cost? What a team of 5, 10 or 15 pays.
intro: Most [virtual office](/virtual-office) software costs $5 to $20 a person a month, so a team of 10 pays between $50 and $200 a month. A few charge for the office instead of the person, and some free plans fit a team of up to 10 with limits on time or meetings. Every price below is from the product's own pricing page, checked on 3 November 2026. We make TinyFloor, one of the ten, so we're not neutral; we've kept to what each page says.
takeaways: Priced per person, a virtual office costs $4.80 to $20 a month for each member: $48 to $200 a month for a team of 10.
Two of the ten price by the office or space instead: TinyFloor at $29 a month for the whole office, and oVice from $65 a month for a small space.
Paying yearly saves about 10% to 20% where it's offered. Roam and TinyFloor bill monthly only.
Every free plan has a limit that matters: people, hours a day, meeting length, or a public space.
Minimums change what a small team pays: Sococo bills at least 10 seats and Kumospace at least 5 members.

sections.title: How is virtual office software priced?
body: Almost every virtual office charges in one of four ways, and the way it charges matters more than the headline number once you multiply it by your team.

items.title: Per person
items.body: A price for each member, user or seat, every month. [Gather](https://www.gather.town/pricing), [Kumospace](https://www.kumospace.com/pricing), [SoWork](https://www.sowork.com/pricing), [Spot](https://www.spotvirtual.com/pricing), [WorkAdventure](https://workadventu.re/pricing/) and [SpatialChat](https://spatial.chat/pricing) work this way; [what Gather costs](/guides/gather-pricing) goes into its plans in detail. The bill grows with every hire.

items.title: Per active member
items.body: [Roam charges $19.50 a month](https://ro.am/pricing) only for members who used it that month, billed monthly with no yearly plan.

items.title: Per office or space
items.body: One price for the space, whoever is in it. [TinyFloor Pro is $29 a month](/pricing) for the whole office; [oVice's Entry-S is $65 a month](https://www.ovice.com/pricing) billed yearly for a space of about 10 regular members.

items.title: Per seat, with a minimum and minutes
items.body: [Sococo is $13.49 a seat a month](https://www.sococo.com/pricing/), prepaid yearly, for at least 10 seats, with 500 minutes a seat each month and $5 for each extra 1,000 minutes.

sections.title: What does a team of 5, 10 or 15 pay each month?
body: Billed monthly, before tax. A team of 10 pays from $29 to $200 a month depending on the product, a difference of nearly seven times for a similar set of rooms, calls and chat. For another team size, the [virtual office cost calculator](/tools/virtual-office-cost-calculator) works it out from the same prices.

sections.title: What do the free plans include?
body: Six of the ten have a free plan, and each is limited in a different way; the [virtual office software comparison](/guides/best-virtual-office-software) covers what else sets them apart. A free plan that fits your whole team beats any paid one; a free plan that cuts every meeting short, or that anyone can walk into, may not.

items.title: Minimums
items.body: [Sococo bills at least 10 seats](https://www.sococo.com/pricing/), so a team of 5 pays for 10. [Kumospace Business](https://www.kumospace.com/pricing) needs at least 5 members, and [oVice's per-user Business Starter](https://www.ovice.com/pricing) starts at 20 users, $320 a month.

items.title: Hours included
items.body: [Gather's Essential plan](https://www.gather.town/pricing) includes recordings starting at 20 hours, and transcription and guest hosting starting at 30 hours. [Sococo includes 500 minutes a seat](https://www.sococo.com/pricing/) each month. If your team meets a lot, check what happens past the limit.

items.title: Guests
items.body: [Gather charges for members, not guests](https://www.gather.town/pricing), and [Roam's guests are free](https://ro.am/pricing). [Kumospace includes 50 guests](https://www.kumospace.com/pricing), who can each be in for up to 4 hours a week.

items.title: Price changes
items.body: [Roam has published its 2027 price](https://ro.am/pricing), $20.88 an active member a month. [TinyFloor's $29 is a founding price](/pricing) for offices that subscribe before 1 March 2027, kept while they stay subscribed; new subscriptions after that are $39.

items.title: Recordings and AI
items.body: Recordings, transcripts and AI notes are often what separates a cheaper plan from a dearer one: [SoWork keeps unlimited recordings and AI summaries for Premium](https://www.sowork.com/pricing), $12 a member a month yearly, and [Kumospace keeps recording for Business](https://www.kumospace.com/pricing).

items.title: A team that works together every day
items.body: Per-person pricing makes every new teammate a new cost, and the [research on remote work](/blog/remote-work-statistics) suggests the teams who get most from a virtual office are the ones in it all day. A price for the office stays the same as the team grows, so it suits a team that wants everyone in, all day.

items.title: A team whose size changes month to month
items.body: [Roam's active-member billing](https://ro.am/pricing) means you don't pay for someone who didn't use it that month.

items.title: A team that needs recordings, AI notes or single sign-on
items.body: Expect to pay per person on a higher plan: [Gather includes recordings and AI notes](https://www.gather.town/pricing) within its hours, [SoWork puts them on Premium](https://www.sowork.com/pricing), and single sign-on is usually on custom or enterprise plans, though [oVice includes it in its Entry spaces](https://www.ovice.com/pricing).

items.title: A team trying it for a week
items.body: Use a trial before a free plan with limits: [Gather](https://www.gather.town/pricing) and [Spot](https://www.spotvirtual.com/pricing) give 30 days, [Roam](https://ro.am/pricing) and [Kumospace](https://www.kumospace.com/pricing) 14, [TinyFloor 14 days of Pro](/pricing) for the whole team, and [SoWork](https://www.sowork.com/pricing) 7. Most don't need a card.

fit.title: Where TinyFloor fits
fit.body: TinyFloor is a virtual office in the browser for a team that works together every day: walk up to a teammate to talk, meet in the meeting room, with chat and screen sharing. Pro is one price for the whole office, $29 a month, not a price per person, and every new office starts with 14 days of Pro, no card needed. It has no recordings, AI notes or single sign-on, so if you need those, a per-person plan above will suit you better.

faq.q: How much does virtual office software cost?
faq.a: Most virtual office software costs $5 to $20 a person a month, or $50 to $200 a month for a team of 10. A few charge per office instead: TinyFloor Pro is $29 a month for the whole office, and oVice's smallest space is $65 a month billed yearly. Prices checked on 3 November 2026.

faq.q: Which virtual offices charge per team instead of per person?
faq.a: TinyFloor charges one price for the whole office, $29 a month. oVice's Entry plans are a flat price per space, from $65 a month billed yearly. Roam charges per active member, so only the people who used it that month.

faq.q: Is there a free virtual office?
faq.a: Yes, with limits. SoWork is free for 10 members with 30-minute meetings, WorkAdventure for 10 people at once, SpatialChat for 12 people for 2 hours a day, Kumospace for 5 members in a public space, and TinyFloor for 3 people. Gather, Spot, Roam and Sococo have trials instead.

faq.q: Is a yearly plan worth it?
faq.a: It saves about 10% to 20% where it's offered, but it's paid up front. Once the team is sure it will keep using the tool, it's worth it; while you're still deciding, pay monthly.

faq.q: Do virtual offices charge for guests?
faq.a: Usually not. Gather charges for members, not guests, Roam's guests are free, and Kumospace includes 50 guests who can each be in for up to 4 hours a week.
